facts.note: Maker gives one dial range; our spec splits by thread count. Verify against the manual before changing.

site.juki: 0.75 to 4 mm, dial adjustable, with an automatic rolled hem setting.

facts.value: 2 to 1 ratio gathering; 3 to 4 ratio stretching
facts.note: Maker writes ratios as 2:1 and 3:4 (0.75). Our 0.6 lower bound is not on the spec sheet.

site.label: Differential feed
site.juki: Full-featured single-unit differential feed: 2 to 1 gathering, 3 to 4 stretching.

facts.value: 4/3/2 thread serging; rolled hem and flatlock with 2 or 3 threads
